support_claim: Unresolved-preservation evidence shows an alternative registry entity and that legal has not determined the contracting party, so identity between billing:Northbridge Analytics Inc. and contract:MSA-NBA-2021 cannot be established.

propositions.proposition: Billing and the MSA both use the name "Northbridge Analytics Inc.", while sales uses the short name "Northbridge Analytics".
propositions.relevance: The left referent is a billing name; the right referent is contract MSA-NBA-2021. This notes aligned naming between billing and the MSA counterparty label, but does not establish registry-level identity between the two referents.

propositions.proposition: A 2024 credit check returned a Wyoming LLC named "Northbridge Analytics LLC".
propositions.relevance: An alternative registry entity exists alongside the billing and contract names, preserving multiple live candidates for the contracting party.

propositions.proposition: Legal has not determined which registry entity is the contracting party, and the registry link should be treated as unresolved.
propositions.relevance: The packet explicitly preserves that identity between billing:Northbridge Analytics Inc. and contract:MSA-NBA-2021 cannot be established at this time.

propositions.proposition: The billed name on invoices is "Northbridge Analytics Inc."
propositions.relevance: Grounds the left referent billing:Northbridge Analytics Inc. to an observed billing record name; name match alone does not establish identity with the contract referent.

propositions.proposition: MSA-NBA-2021 lists the counterparty as "Northbridge Analytics, Inc." with an effective date of 4 June 2021.
propositions.relevance: Grounds the right referent contract:MSA-NBA-2021 to a named counterparty on the agreement; compatible naming with the billing referent is insufficient to establish they denote the same legal counterparty.
